sources.title: Forge3D — AI 3D Model Generator — Text & Image to 3D
sources.snippet: Forge3D is an AI 3D model generator that turns text prompts and images into game-ready, textured 3D models in seconds — with one-click rigging, animation, GLB/FBX export, and a developer API. Free to start, and cheaper per model than Meshy or Rodin.

sources.title: Forge3D — AI 3D Model Generator
sources.snippet: Describe your 3D model or upload a reference image. Be as detailed or simple as you like. Select from Realistic, Cartoon, Low-Poly, or Sculpture styles for your model. Meshy AI processes your request and generates a fully textured 3D model in seconds. Preview in the interactive 3D viewer and download in your preferred format.

sources.title: Explore AI-generated 3D models - forge3d.ai
sources.snippet: Explore AI-generated 3D models Real models made with Forge3D from a single text prompt or image — characters, creatures, props, vehicles and environments. Preview any one in 3D, then generate your own.

sources.title: Free AI 3D Model Generator - MeshGPT
sources.snippet: Create stunning 3D models from text or images instantly with our free AI 3d model generator. Transform your ideas into production-ready 3D assets with MeshGPT.

sources.title: AI 3D Model Generator: Create 3D from Text & Images | Meshy
sources.snippet: Meshy's AI 3D model generator turns text and images into production-ready 3D models in 20-30 seconds. Export to FBX, OBJ, GLB, and STL formats. Try Meshy free.
